chunks: Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā, from Yaʿqūb ibn Yazīd, from Ziyād ibn Marwān al-Qandī, from Yūnus ibn Ẓabyān, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم forbade that salat (prayer) be performed upon a grave, or that one sit upon it, or that something be built over it.

key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.نَهَى: he forbade; indicates prohibition in the narration

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم forbid regarding graves?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a legal prohibition from the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم concerning certain forms of conduct related to graves. It indicates the impermissibility of performing salat on a grave, sitting on it, or building over it, reflecting prescribed etiquette and legal limits regarding burial places.
